title: orthosiphon aristatus
intro: Orthosiphon aristatus, commonly known as Misai Kucing or Cat's Whiskers, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Malaysia and Indonesia. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which help to alleviate symptoms of kidney stones, urinary tract infections, and high blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Orthosiphon aristatus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which exhibit anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and anti-proliferative properties. Regular consumption of Misai Kucing tea or extract is believed to promote overall health and well-being by modulating the immune system and reducing oxidative stress.
